summary: Grass strip at the end of a street, ringed by riverfront homes.
reasons: Houses 21 m away on both sides
Strip looks like private riverfront yards
No vehicles or tyre tracks seen

drivers.seclusion: Homes within 21 to 22 m to the north and south, and more within 80 m; the ring sits between private garden lots.
drivers.access_and_room: The mapped gravel track leaves the end of the street and runs onto mown grass; no tyre tracks or parked vehicles, and it reads as access to the adjoining properties.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac end; no through traffic.
drivers.convention: No sign anyone parks or stays here.

flags: Steep: up to 38% max on the bank beside the track, about 10% mean
Low-lying: 4 to 9 m elevation, Brisbane River 102 m away, flood-prone
Likely private access to riverside lots
sun_shade: Open grass; tall hedge shades from the south, trees to the north shade the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the land is private or public
